arabic text: ASGHAR KO LEKE GOWD ME KEHTI HAI KARBALA\nYE WO ALI HAI JISKO KABHI GHAR NAHIN MILA
english translation text: THE LAND OF KARBALA CRADLES ALIASGHAR AND SAYS\nTHIS IS THAT ALI THAT HAS NEVER SEEN A HOME

arabic text: CHEH MAAH KE GHAREEB MUSAFIR KO SOMPKE\nKEHNE LAGE HUSSAIN YEH KABRE SAGHEER SE\nRAKHNA ZARA KHAYAAL MERE TISHNA KAAM KA
english translation text: IMAM BURIED THE SIX MONTH OLD LITTLE TRAVELLER\nIMAM SAT NEAR THE GRAVE AND SAID TEARFULLY\nLOOK AFTER MY LITTLE THIRSTY BABY

arabic text: MADAR YE BEYN KARTI THI DILME HAI YE KASAK\nSUGHRA TUMHARI GOWD SE AAGHOSH QABR TAK\nASGHAR KO MOWT NE KAHI RUK NE NAHI DIYA
english translation text: MOTHER WAILS AND CRIES THAT THERE IS PAIN IN MY HEART\nSUGHRA FROM YOUR LAPS TO THE LAP OF GRAVE\nDEATH FOLLOWED ASGHAR AND DID NOT STOP

arabic text: MA SOCHTI THI DHALTA HAI DIN HO RAHI HAI SHAAM\nJULE ME LOWT AYEGA SHAYAD WO TISHNA KAAM\nLAIKIN GHAZAB HUWA KE WO JULA BHI JAL GAYA
english translation text: MOTHER WONDERS THAT SUN IS SETTING AND EVENING DRAWS\nMAYBE MY THIRSTY BABY WILL RETURN TO THE CRADLE\nBUT CALAMITY HAS BEFALLEN AND CRADLE IS BURNT

arabic text: GALIYON ME SHEHR KUFA KI BAZAAR SHAAM ME\nSHEEREEN KE GHAR KABHI KABHI DARBAARE SHAAM ME\nMARNE KE BAAD BHI ALI ASGHAR SAFAR ME THA
english translation text: IN THE LANES OF KUFA AND BAZAARS OF SHAM\nIN THE HOUSE OF SHIRIN AND IN THE COURT OF YAZID\nEVEN AFTER DEATH ALI ASGHAR IS NOT AT REST

arabic text: NANNE SE SAR KO YAAS SE BAS TAK TE REHTE THE\nPHIR KHUN ROKE SAYYADE SAJJAD KEHTE THE\nME WO ALI HUN JISKA BHARA GHAR UJAR GAYA
english translation text: HE WOULD JUST LOOK AT THE LITTLE HEAD WITH DESPAIR\nIMAM SAJJAD SHED THE TEARS OF BLOOD AND SAID\nI AM THAT ALI WHOSE ENTIRE HOUSE WAS DESICRATED

arabic text: JAANE LAGA WATAN JO GHAREEBON KA KAARVAAN\nMUR MUR KE KEHTI JATI THI EK KHALI GOWD MA\nRAKHIYO SAMBHAAL PHIR ISE AY ARZE NAINAWA
english translation text: AS THE CARAVAN IS TRYING TO RETURN HOME\nMOTHER WAS DYING AND CRYING AT HER EMPTY LAP\nTAKE GOOD CARE OF MY LITTLE BABY O LAND OF KARBALA

arabic text: DAR HAI YE PHIRSE KOI SINA PAR UTHA NA LE\nLIPTA HUWA HAI ABHI WO SINE SE BAAP KE\nRO RO KE KEHRAHI HAI TAKALLUM YE KARBALA
english translation text: THIS THOUGHT SCARES ME A LOT THAT O TAKALLUM\nWHAT IF SOME OTHER CRUEL SOLDIER PUTS A SPEAR\nIN THE GRAVE AS YOU LIE ON YOUR FATHERS CHEST PEACEFULLY

arabic text: ASGHAR KO LEKE GODH MAY KEHTI HAI KARBALA
english translation text: THE LAND OF KARBALA TOOK ASGHAR IN ITS EMBRACE…
